root_cause_a_duplicate_sources.finding: Audit revealed exactly 1 active hook source (.codex/hooks.json) with 12 handlers. Neither C:\Users\GF63\.codex\hooks.json nor config.toml define duplicate commands.
root_cause_a_duplicate_sources.repetition_origin: Multi-tool calls per agent turn caused repeated hook invocations, each returning rejected output format, rendering 4-5 error banners per turn.

root_cause_b_wire_output_contract.finding: Codex CLI 0.157.1 rejects internal {'decision':'allow'} JSON. PreToolUse and PostToolUse require empty stdout (0 bytes) for normal allow/receipt. Stop and SubagentStop require {'continue': true}.

rules_enforced.PermissionRequest: decision nested object with behavior allow/deny

root_cause_c_stdin_parse_blindspot.finding: Corrupted or empty stdin caused JSONDecodeError without event context in hook_failures.jsonl.
root_cause_c_stdin_parse_blindspot.remediation: Added explicit --event CLI argument to all hook configurations; implemented log_parse_failure() recording sha256, byte length, and json position without leaking prompt data; implemented handle_parse_failure_fallback() with fail-closed exit 2 for PreToolUse and safe continue for Stop.

root_cause_d_matcher_conhost_popup.finding: Codex matcher only inspects toolName regex, not shell commands. Bash tool executions including harmless reads triggered conhost.exe processes.

operational_readiness.interactive_run_instruction: Launch codex with clean environment or --no-daemon flag for interactive validation.
